title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Maya Patel
description: Add a set of opinionated RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, example tool-calling integrations, and corresponding docs quickstarts to help developers get started quickly. Motivation: reduce friction for engineers building RAG+agent workflows by providing production-aligned templates (retriever + prompt + tool interfaces) and runnable examples. Changes include: new example templates for FAQ and ticket summarization agents, a tool-calling example that demonstrates safe external API calls + structured JSON outputs, updated quickstart docs with step-by-step instructions and screenshots, and minor updates to examples CI to run lightweight scenario tests. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG agent templates and examples - [x] Add tool-calling example with mock tool server - [x] Docs quickstart and step-by-step walkthrough - [x] Add integration smoke tests - [x] Update examples CI to run smoke tests - [x] Add changelog entry Context and notes: these templates follow the same config patterns used by the existing agent runner; where appropriate the examples demonstrate Redwood OpenAI-compat API usage and explicit parameter pinning for deterministic evaluation. See linked Linear tickets for rollout plan and follow-ups. How to test locally: run `examples/rag/README.md` instructions, start the included mock-tool server, run `yarn test:smoke` or `python -m pytest tests/smoke_test.py`. Docs site: added quickstart page under docs/quickstarts/rag-agent.md and updated sidebar config. This PR is intended to be non-breaking and additive; no runtime changes to the server.
